Keyords are words and short phrases with a specified meaning used widely in Mewgenics. 

They can have a wide range of uses, for example all [[Status Effects]] are considered keywords.

== Keywords ==
These have an icon and an apropriate tooltip describing what they are.

{{Shuffle Keywords}}

== Non-Icon Properties ==
These are not tracked and explained as Keywords by the game, however are still recurrent properties that have a specific meaning the player is expected to know.

=== Alternative Movement Actions ===
Movement actions which are not the default "Move". 
* Cats can have their movement actions replaced by certain effects. 
** [[List of effects that replace movement action]]
* Some enemies innately have a different movement action.
; {{anchor|Jump}}
; {{anchor|Teleport}}
; {{anchor|Dig}}
; {{anchor|Shadowstep}}
: Unit moves from one tile to another directly, ignoring tile effects and units in the way.
: {{st|Trample}} allows to jump/teleport/dig on-to other units that can be displaced.
: Difference between them is just visual and sounds.


; Jump (Damaging)
: Some sources of Jump innately deal {{icon|Physical damage}}, often not differentiated in descriptions.
:: They can innately be used to jump on to other units.
::: This includes units immune to being displaced.
:: Their damage overrides {{st|Trample}} damage, just dealing the Jumps damage.
:: Jumping on a unit that can be displaced, displaces them
::: Otherwise, displaces the user.
:: Activates both units on-contact effects.


; {{anchor|Dash Attack}}
: Unit moves as far as possible in one cardinal direction, until it collides with another unit, dealing damage to it.
:: Activates victims on-contact effects.
:: {{st|Trample}} will have no effect.

|- id="Levitating Rock"
! id="Levitating" | Levitating Rock
| 
{{type|Rock}} start levitating after certain effects.
: Will stop Levitating if damaged.
: Downed Rocks cannot levitate.

Levitating rocks will automatically fling themselves toward units which end their movement perpendicularly to the rock, and are considered an enemy by the caster.
: Both units take {{icon|Knockback damage}}.
: Without a caster, any unit will be targeted.
: Will stop Levitating after being triggered.
:

|- id="Refresh"
! Refresh
| 
Basic attacks, movement actions, weapons and trinket actions can be refreshed.<br>
Refreshing a units action means giving it 1 action point for that action, if it had 0 remaining.

Refreshing an action when it is not out of uses will not add an additional use to be used later in that turn, effectively doing nothing.

<!--Says reload in game when it procs-->
{{st|Bonus Attack}} / {{st|Bonus Move}} count as action points, preventing the action from being refreshed until they've used up the respective status effect.

Refreshing a weapon or trinket with a once per battle restriction allows it to be used once again.
|
